summary.en: Yumi recalls when she, Yagi, and Momosaki charged three men for breaking traffic laws, specifically: Kengo Aono was charged for smartphone usage while driving, he even forgot his driving license. Yuuzou Shiroyama was charged for driving without equipping seatbelt and overdue inspection (driving license expired, as some specific driving licenses would require prolonging when expired). All three of them reacted harshly because they were in a hurry at the time, but were eventually taken to the police station for resisting an officer on duty. Conan leaves the scene to go to school with Haibara and the Detective Boys, on the way, he tells them about the scene of the murder. Sato asks Yumi for the information of the three suspects before the latter goes back to her department and sees Naeko praying for Momosaki. Meanwhile, Yagi arrives at the place where she had assumed the culprit is staying at and confronts that person. This doesn’t turn out to be very good for her as she suffers the same fate as the previous victim, leaving a phone that is trying to call 7155 before getting it smashed as well. After being tasered from the apartment, she was thrown off the balcony. However, she wasn't dead completely.
